name: Personalized Wooden Frame LED Light
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a durable natural wooden frame and premium clear acrylic hanging pieces.
    - Wooden frame thickness: 4 cm ~ 1.58 in, providing stability and an elegant rustic appearance.
    - Acrylic thickness: 3 mm, lightweight yet sturdy for long-lasting display.
    - Includes high-quality metal circular rings for securely connecting the hanging pieces.
    - Built-in LED strip illuminates the acrylic ornaments beautifully, creating a warm and eye-catching display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden Frame Size: 24 x 24 cm ~ 9.45 x 9.45 in
    - Frame depth: 4 cm ~ 1.58 in
    - Custom Acrylic Pieces: 4 x 4 cm ~ 1.58 x 1.58 in
    - Available Layouts:
            +) Cluster 1: 4 custom pieces
            +) Cluster 2: 4 custom pieces
            +) Cluster 3: 4 custom pieces
            +) Cluster 4: 4 custom pieces
    📌 Note: The size of the wooden frame is fixed and cannot be changed. The dimensions of the acrylic piece may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and crisp details.
    - Supports double-sided printing on custom acrylic pieces.

 

  • LED Lighting Features:
    - Powered by USB connection for convenient everyday use.
    - Available in:
            +) 7-Color LED Version
            +) Monochrome LED Version
    - Built-in controller allows:
            +) Brightness adjustment
            +) Light color selection
            +) Dynamic color-changing modes
            +) Fast and slow transition effects
    - Memory function automatically remembers the last brightness and color setting used.
    - 7 LED Colors Include: Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Purple, White.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Personalized LED display that combines meaningful memories with beautiful lighting.
    - Perfect for showcasing family photos, birth flowers, pet portraits, names, or special messages.
    - Creates a warm and cozy atmosphere with customizable LED lighting effects.
    - Features hanging acrylic pieces that add depth and movement to the display.
    - Suitable for decorating bedrooms, living rooms, offices, nurseries, and study spaces.
    - Compact tabletop design that fits easily on desks, shelves, nightstands, and mantels.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Personalized gift for family members, friends, couples, and loved ones
    - Perfect for birthdays and anniversaries
    - Ideal for Mother's Day and Father's Day
    - Thoughtful gift for Valentine's Day and weddings
    - Meaningful memorial or remembrance keepsake
    - Great gift for pet lovers and flower enthusiasts
    - Beautiful decoration for Christmas and holiday celebrations
    - A unique way to preserve cherished memories in an illuminated display 🎁

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
